criticalLow.title: 🚨 Water {{cropName}} NOW
criticalLow.description: Soil moisture is critically low at {{value}}{{unit}}. Your crop is at risk of severe stress.
criticalLow.reason: Moisture below {{optimalMin}}% causes wilting, stunted growth, and potential crop loss.
criticalLow.impact: Immediate watering can prevent irreversible damage

warningLow.title: 💧 Schedule watering for {{cropName}}
warningLow.description: Moisture at {{value}}{{unit}} is below optimal. Water within the next few hours.
warningLow.reason: Current level is approaching stress territory. Optimal range is {{optimalMin}}-{{optimalMax}}%.
warningLow.impact: Early watering improves crop health and yield

criticalHigh.title: ⚠️ Check drainage - Overwatering detected
criticalHigh.description: Moisture at {{value}}{{unit}} is too high. Risk of root rot and disease.
criticalHigh.reason: Excess water suffocates roots and promotes fungal growth.
criticalHigh.impact: Improve drainage to save your crop

optimal.title: ✅ {{cropName}} moisture is perfect
optimal.description: Soil moisture at {{value}}{{unit}} is within optimal range.
optimal.reason: Your irrigation schedule is working well.

criticalLow.title: ❄️ Frost Alert - Protect {{cropName}}
criticalLow.description: Temperature at {{value}}{{unit}} is dangerously low. Risk of frost damage.
criticalLow.reason: Temperatures below {{optimalMin}}°C can freeze plant cells and kill tissue.
criticalLow.impact: Cover crops or activate heating immediately

criticalHigh.title: 🌡️ Heat Stress - Cool {{cropName}}
criticalHigh.description: Temperature at {{value}}{{unit}} is too high. Crops are stressed.
criticalHigh.reason: High temperatures cause wilting, sunburn, and reduced growth.

warningLow.title: 🌡️ Temperature dropping for {{cropName}}
warningLow.description: Temperature at {{value}}{{unit}} is below optimal but not critical.
warningLow.reason: Cool temperatures slow growth but aren't immediately harmful.
warningLow.impact: Monitor closely and prepare protection if needed

criticalHigh.title: 💨 High humidity - Improve ventilation
criticalHigh.description: Humidity at {{value}}{{unit}} increases disease risk for {{cropName}}.
criticalHigh.reason: High humidity promotes fungal diseases like powdery mildew and blight.
criticalHigh.impact: Increase airflow to reduce disease pressure

criticalLow.title: 💦 Low humidity - Consider misting
criticalLow.description: Humidity at {{value}}{{unit}} is too low for optimal growth.
criticalLow.reason: Low humidity causes plant stress and increased water demand.
criticalLow.impact: Light misting can help maintain leaf health

soon.title: 📅 Harvest approaching for {{cropName}}
soon.description: Expected harvest date is within the next 7 days.
soon.reason: Prepare equipment and plan logistics for harvesting.
soon.impact: Timely harvest ensures best quality and yield

ready.title: 🌾 {{cropName}} is ready to harvest!
ready.description: Your crop has reached maturity. Harvest within the next few days for best quality.
ready.reason: Delaying harvest may reduce quality or cause overripening.
ready.impact: Harvest at peak for maximum value

seedling.title: 🌱 {{cropName}} in seedling stage
seedling.description: Your crop is in early growth. Focus on consistent moisture and protection.
seedling.reason: Seedlings are delicate and need careful attention.
seedling.impact: Good early care leads to strong, healthy plants

flowering.title: 🌸 {{cropName}} is flowering
flowering.description: Consider applying fertilizer to support flower and fruit development.
flowering.reason: Flowering stage has high nutrient demands.
flowering.impact: Proper nutrition during flowering improves yield

rainExpected.title: 🌧️ Rain expected - Skip watering
rainExpected.description: Rain is forecast. Save water by skipping today's irrigation.
rainExpected.reason: Natural rainfall will provide sufficient moisture.

frostWarning.title: ❄️ Frost warning tonight
frostWarning.description: Temperatures expected to drop below freezing. Protect sensitive crops.
frostWarning.reason: Frost can cause severe damage to unprotected plants.
frostWarning.impact: Cover crops or activate heating systems

heatWarning.title: ☀️ Extreme heat expected
heatWarning.description: High temperatures forecast. Increase watering and provide shade.
heatWarning.reason: Heat stress reduces growth and can damage crops.
heatWarning.impact: Extra care during heat waves prevents losses

who.label: Who we are

who.content:
FEED IN GREEN is a company specialized in smart Agritech solutions and connected agriculture.

We support farmers, entrepreneurs, businesses and communities in designing and deploying innovative, sustainable and high-performance agricultural projects.

Our approach combines advanced technologies, agricultural engineering and field-level support adapted to local and urban realities.

Design and deploy smart agritech solutions to optimize agricultural production, reduce resource usage and promote sustainable and resilient agriculture.

FEED IN GREEN is committed to offering accessible, efficient and scalable solutions, addressing current challenges of food security, climate change and growing urbanization.

faqs.a: Our installation timelines vary from 2 to 6 weeks depending on project complexity. A detailed schedule is provided upon contract signing.

faqs.q: Do you offer a trial period?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer a free on-site demonstration so you can evaluate our solutions before any commitment.

faqs.q: What support do you offer after installation?
faqs.a: We offer complete technical support: phone assistance, remote maintenance, and on-site interventions if needed.

faqs.q: Do your solutions work without internet?
faqs.a: Our systems are designed to work in local mode even without an internet connection. Data is synchronized as soon as the connection is restored.

faqs.q: What types of projects do you prioritize?
faqs.a: We support all types of projects: from small individual greenhouses to industrial installations, including urban farming projects and collective training. Every request is studied with the same attention.

INTRO.LABEL: Sustainable Design
INTRO.TITLE: Solutions Adapted to Tunisian Terrain
INTRO.SUBTITLE: From tunnel greenhouses to shade structures, agricultural plastics, and fixing equipment, we provide everything needed to protect and optimize your crops under local climate conditions.

SERRE_MULTI_CHAPELLE.NAME: Multi-Span Greenhouse
SERRE_MULTI_CHAPELLE.DESC: A greenhouse composed of several attached spans. Thanks to its robust galvanized steel structure and plastic film or polycarbonate cover, it guarantees excellent resistance to climatic conditions. It creates a controlled environment, ideal for maximizing agricultural yield year-round.
SPECS: Modular structure adaptable to your needs
Side and roof ventilation for optimal climate
Compatible with irrigation and fertigation systems
Cover: agricultural plastic, polycarbonate, or net

SERRE_TUNNEL.NAME: Tunnel Greenhouse
SERRE_TUNNEL.DESC: The tunnel greenhouse is a simple, economic, and effective solution to protect your crops year-round. Its hoop structure covered with plastic film creates a microclimate favorable for plant growth. Easy to install and maintain, it is particularly suited for small and medium-sized farms.

SERRE_JARDIN.NAME: Garden Greenhouse
SERRE_JARDIN.DESC: The garden greenhouse is ideal for gardening enthusiasts wanting to grow plants under optimal conditions. It protects crops against bad weather, cold, and climate variations while promoting growth. Compact and aesthetic, it easily fits into any garden.
SPECS: Lightweight aluminum or galvanized steel structure

STRUCTURE_OMBRIERE.NAME: Shade Structure
STRUCTURE_OMBRIERE.DESC: The shade structure is designed to protect crops against excessive sunlight and heat. Equipped with shade nets, it reduces light intensity while ensuring good air circulation. Ideal for nurseries, sensitive crops, and hot climate areas.
SPECS: Shade nets available in different rates (50%, 70%)
Adapted to different types of crops

EQUIPEMENTS_SERRES.NAME: Greenhouse Equipment
EQUIPEMENTS_SERRES.DESC: We offer a complete range of equipment for agricultural greenhouses. Designed with materials resistant to corrosion and climatic conditions, our products ensure a reliable, durable installation adapted to all types of structures.
SPECS: Fixing clips: secure hold of plastic film, UV resistance
Galvanized hoops: robust structure, high corrosion resistance
Clamps: solid and durable assembly of elements
Tension wire (Nylstrong): optimal hold, tensile strength
Screws and bolts: reliable fixing, long lifespan
Mounting accessories: simple and fast installation

PLASTIQUE_SERRE.NAME: Greenhouse Plastic
PLASTIQUE_SERRE.DESC: Greenhouse plastic is an essential element to protect your crops and create an optimal environment for their development. It maintains temperature, protects against wind and rain, while letting through the light necessary for photosynthesis.
SPECS: Materials: polyethylene (PE), polycarbonate, or UV stabilized film
Transparent or diffusing depending on the crop type
Resistant to bad weather and temperature variations

SCOTCH_REPARATION.NAME: Plastic Repair Tape
SCOTCH_REPARATION.DESC: Greenhouse plastic repair tape is a practical and essential accessory to extend the life of your plastic films. It allows you to quickly repair tears, cracks, or holes in your greenhouses without having to replace the entire film.
SPECS: Powerful adhesive compatible with polyethylene and polycarbonate

TOILE_HORS_SOL.NAME: Ground Cover Fabric
TOILE_HORS_SOL.DESC: Ground cover fabric is a protective covering intended to cover your crops or structures without direct contact with the soil. It offers effective protection against wind, sun, and certain pests, while promoting plant development.
SPECS: Adapted to crops on tables or soilless structures

FILET_PROTECTION.NAME: Protection Net
FILET_PROTECTION.DESC: Optimize your agricultural performance with our complete range of technical nets and professional fabrics. Our shade nets, insect-proof, and anti-hail nets offer overall protection of your crops against climatic and biological attacks.
SPECS: Shade nets: precise regulation of sunshine and heat reduction
Insect-proof nets: effective barrier against pests with excellent ventilation
Anti-hail nets: reinforced protection against impacts and bad weather
Ground covers: optimal weed control and effective moisture management
